questions.stem: A 44-year-old female who is a known case of scleroderma presented with shortness of breath, especially during exercise. She underwent right heart catheterization, and her mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP) was 35 mm Hg. Which of the following is true regarding her condition? (NEET PG 2024)

options.label: A
options.text: CCBs are the first line in all patients

options.label: C
options.text: Lung transplant is the best treatment if identified early
